title: docs(skills): translate the wave-1a internal instruction-surface stock to Chinese
body:
Part of #8958 — wave 1a of the Chinese-stock translation. The card stays open for waves 1b and 2.

**ADR-class: human merge only.** Skills updates are ADR-level (maintainer ruling 2026-08-11: 「所有 skills 的更新和adr 类似,需要人工审核」) — do not merge, queue, or arm auto-merge; the maintainer's merge is the veto window.

## Provenance (2026-08-16, verbatim, untranslated)

> 我建议存量你一次性处理为中文。

> .claude/skills/** 用中文，给客户的 skills 不要改。

## What changed

Semantics-preserving translation only — no rule changes meaning, scope, strength, or ordering. Machine anchors (frontmatter blocks, commands, script/gate names, paths, JSON keys, enum values, labels, title formats, code blocks) stay English byte-stable; frontmatter md5-verified identical for all four SKILL.md files. One commit per file for bisectability.

**Scope note (card premise, partially invalid):** six of the ten files in the card's table were already Chinese-dominant at the fetched head; four of them carried zero English narrative and were left byte-identical (no padding, per the ratchet clause). The real stock was the four standalone SKILL.md files plus two one-line residuals.

## Translation judgment calls

1. **review-checklist.md** — "You are the reviewer of record" translated as 记录在案的复核人 with the English term kept as a parenthetical gloss: pm-dispatch/SKILL.md (wave 2) still carries the same English sentence, so the gloss preserves the cross-file echo until wave 2 converges both.
2. **platform-readings.md** — the aside "(the file, not the history, is the operand)" rendered as a Chinese restatement (操作数是文件本身,不是历史).
3. **dispatch-runbook.md** — the parenthetical "(record-and-walk-away)" kept in English: the Chinese name 记录后离场 immediately precedes it; the parenthetical is a named-anti-pattern handle, not untranslated prose. Same for "Definition of done", which names a section anchor in the os-dev agent definition.
4. **spec-property-retirement** — pre-existing issue/PR citations preserved verbatim (semantics-preserving; verified this file is outside check:pm-skill-id-lint's scan set, which covers only .claude/skills/pm-dispatch, the os-dev definition, and AGENTS.md). The ledger note template blockquote, the guidance-string literal fragments, and the bash gate loop stay byte-stable English — they are artifact templates and message literals that get pasted into English-language surfaces, not narrative.
5. **checklist-author** — the hunter output-contract column names (surface | evidence path | coverage verdict | proposed id | sketch | fixture?) stay English: they define subagent report fields.
6. **checklist-test** — selector literals, verdict enums (blocked/partial/pass and their parenthesized reasons), labels (qa-run, bug, regression) and the QA-run issue-title format stay English byte-stable.
7. **dogfood-verification** — the beforeunload JS escape hatch, all commands/env vars/URLs, and the drifted-build citation stay byte-stable.
8. Terminology converged on pm-dispatch/SKILL.md's established vocabulary (门禁/台账/墓碑/退役/把门/假红/假绿/立单/复核/认领/派发…).

**Falsified PM mechanism assumption (for the record):** check:skill-frame-sync's four decision-frame copies live in pm-dispatch/SKILL.md, the os-dev definition, and the published skills/objectstack-pm-dispatch/SKILL.md — references/review-checklist.md carries no copy of the frame (read from scripts/check-skill-frame-sync.mjs COPIES). The gate was run anyway: green.
